settings.name: USE_REAL_IP
settings.description: **Enable Real IP:** Set to `yes` to enable retrieving client's real IP from headers or PROXY protocol.

settings.name: REAL_IP_FROM
settings.description: **Trusted Proxies:** List of trusted IP addresses or networks where proxied requests come from, separated by spaces.

settings.name: REAL_IP_HEADER
settings.description: **Real IP Header:** HTTP header containing the real IP or special value `proxy_protocol` for PROXY protocol.

settings.name: REAL_IP_RECURSIVE
settings.description: **Recursive Search:** When set to `yes`, performs a recursive search in header containing multiple IP addresses.

settings.name: REAL_IP_FROM_URLS
settings.description: **IP List URLs:** URLs containing trusted proxy IPs/networks to download, separated by spaces. Supports file:// URLs.

settings.name: USE_PROXY_PROTOCOL
settings.description: **PROXY Protocol:** Set to `yes` to enable PROXY protocol support for direct proxy-to-BunkerWeb communication.
